name: High Roller Suite
description: Congratulations, gambler: a key temporarily turning any door into a gate to the High Roller Suite, a luxury hotel room with 3 beds, 2 bathrooms, running water, electricity, heat, local internet, and other amenities. It auto-cleans perfectly every 24 hours, exists in the middle of nowhere and requires the key to exit, returning users to their entry point. The key cannot be lost or destroyed.
